SOG FRAMEWORK

Clarity → Action → Transformation
No matter which plan you choose, you go through the same three steps that turn goals into results.

#1. CLARITY.
You align your career interests and identity, then set the one goal your quarter is built around. You lead with intention and confidence.

#2. ACTION.
You execute daily. Every day, you focus on your 3 High-Impact Tasks (HITs), or Brand Building Tasks (BBTs) if you’re a Visionary. Accountability keeps you from dropping the ball.

#3. TRANSFORMATION.
You close the quarter with visible progress on your goal, and you carry the habits, confidence, and momentum into the next one. Wins compound.
